editorial.blurb: This beloved Hawaiian spot delivers generous, nostalgic plates that transport you straight to the islands—from expertly seasoned loco moco to crispy chicken katsu.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Mini Hamburger Steak and request an extra side of brown gravy to really make it sing when mixed with the rice; it's a sleeper hit that rivals the famous loco moco.

topDishes.note: Gravy, beef, and eggs meld perfectly—exactly as it should be
Consistent, reliable favorite that hits every single time
